comment: The S.6 negative suite. Every case marked invalid must FAIL validation — a negative that validates is a hole, not a pass. Each case mutates one of the three valid bases so that it fails for exactly the intended reason. `by` names the layer expected to catch it: `schema` is the emitted JSON Schema, `reference` is the check JSON Schema cannot express. A case marked `reference` that the schema also rejects is fine and stronger; a case marked `schema` that only the reference layer catches means the schema has a hole. On the cpipes negative_suite.json pattern (tools/cpipes_contract/), with `by` added because this side validates in two layers.
